انكشفت (form VII)
# اِنْكَشَفْتُ (inkašaftu) /in.ka.ʃaf.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْكَشَفَ (inkašafa)
# اِنْكَشَفْتَ (inkašafta) /in.ka.ʃaf.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْكَشَفَ (inkašafa)
# اِنْكَشَفْتِ (inkašafti) /in.ka.ʃaf.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْكَشَفَ (inkašafa)
# اِنْكَشَفَتْ (inkašafat) /in.ka.ʃa.fat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
